narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
intent: To illustrate the scarcity of arable land and the limited proportion of it that is irrigated.

units.meaning: Arable land is an extremely small share of all land: 0.3% arable versus 99.7% other land.

basis.note: Arable land share of total land.
Other land share of total land.

accepted_routes: Arable land is 0.3% of all land, while other land is 99.7%.
Only 0.3% of land is arable; 99.7% is other land.
Arable land is a tiny share (0.3%) compared with other land (99.7%).
units.visual_evidence_rule: The chart must show arable land and other land as parts of total land, with arable visibly tiny compared to other land and the 0.3% / 99.7% shares identifiable.
units.temporal_anchor: Because less than 1 % of the country's land is arable
units.reviewer_question: Is the near-zero arable share obligatory, or can the video simply say 'less than 1%' without showing 0.3%?

units.meaning: The 33.3% irrigation figure is a share of arable land, not a share of all land.

basis.note: Arable land is the denominator context; it is 0.3% of all land.

accepted_routes: Irrigated arable land is 33.3% of arable land.
The 33.3% irrigation share uses arable land as the denominator.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The chart must make clear that the 33.3% irrigation share is nested within arable land, not total land.
units.temporal_anchor: only a third of which is irrigated
units.reviewer_question: Must the denominator for the 33.3% irrigation share be explicit, or can 'of which' be understood from context?

units.meaning: Within arable land, irrigated arable land is about one-third and not irrigated arable land is about two-thirds.

basis.note: Not irrigated portion of arable land.

accepted_routes: Within arable land, irrigated is 33.3% and not irrigated is 66.7%.
About one-third of arable land is irrigated, about two-thirds is not.
Irrigated arable land (33.3%) is less than not irrigated arable land (66.7%).
units.visual_evidence_rule: The chart must show irrigated arable land and not irrigated arable land as the two parts of arable land, with irrigated about one-third and not irrigated about two-thirds.
units.temporal_anchor: only a third of which is irrigated
units.reviewer_question: Is the exact 33.3% / 66.7% split required, or is 'about one-third / two-thirds' sufficient?

optional_valid: Not irrigated arable land is about twice irrigated arable land (66.7% vs 33.3%).
Within arable land, not irrigated is the larger segment and irrigated is the smaller segment.
Other land is the largest overall category and arable land is the smallest overall category.
unsupported_to_avoid: Irrigated arable land is 33.3% of all land.
Arable land is 33.3% of all land.
Not irrigated land is 66.7% of all land.
Causal claims such as arable scarcity causing food shortages or irrigation limits causing specific outcomes.
Any future trend or change over time, since the table has no time dimension.
Treating relative_value 0.0030 as 0.003% instead of using the table's % value.
notes: The table has two nested share comparisons: arable/other land and irrigated/not irrigated within arable. The key risk is misassigning the 33.3% irrigation share to total land rather than to arable land.
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only
